correctness.rationale: The theta-refinement incidence criterion fixes all 28x63 binary entries. Each of 28 rows has 27 ones and 63 columns 12; all pairwise intersections give BB^t=16I+11J. These determine the exact 91-vertex block Laplacian, its complete spectral tree count 2^124*3^36*7^26*11^27, and possible torsion primes. Reconstructed 90x90 reduced Laplacians with either type of root have exact local Smith valuations: p2 0:28,1:6,2:50,3:6; p3 0:54,1:36; p7 0:64,1:26; p11 0:63,1:27. The included integer modular elimination uses invertible elementary row/column operations, all pivots below precision, confirms mod-p ranks, and checks valuation sums against determinant. Prime alignment gives precisely 1^28,2^6,4^20,12^9,132,924^20,1848^6. Finite exact computation determines the finite graph; conditional semistable geometric component-group interpretation uses the standard graph monodromy theorem.

value.rationale: The 28-bitangent/63-Steiner Levi graph is an intrinsic full configuration attached to every smooth plane quartic in char not two, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its full integral Jacobian is a natural non-rational invariant, detecting 2-primary depth plus torsion at 3,7,11 that is not recoverable simply from rational Gram spectrum or the previously published rectangular incidence cokernel. In addition it supplies the exact geometric Néron component group for regular unit-thickness stable curves with that canonical graph. Exact new calculation is motivated by the gap between rational design parameters and integral graph arithmetic; no theorem-sized broader generalization is asserted.
